issue_context.title: Advantage Air main climate entity doesn't update target temperature when set elsewhere
issue_context.body:
### The problem

I have an Advantage Air e-zone system, with temperature sensors. Everything about the Home Assistant integration seems to work well, except for one thing:

The main climate entity doesn't update when the target myzone temperature is changed from the e-zone tablet or app.

To be a bit more specific, here's an example:
![CleanShot 2023-10-03 at 14 56 42](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/assets/3127419/33ac2647-b059-49bc-9264-2198771d803f)


My temperature mode is set to "MyZone", with the "Downstairs" zone being set as myzone. When I change the target temperature from the e-zone tablet or app, the target temperature on the "downstairs" entity gets updated correctly, but the target temperature for the "main" climate entity doesn't update.

Alternatively, in Home Assistant, if I change the "downstairs" entity target temperature, the e-zone app and tablet all update correctly, but the main climate entity in Home Assistant doesn't reflect the target temperature change.

Finally, if I change the target temperature of the main climate entity from Home Assistant, it does correctly update the downstairs entity, as well as the app/tablet.

So it seems that updates don't seem to be working one way - the main climate zone doesn't receive target temperature changes.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2023.8.3

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Container

### Integration causing the issue

Advantage Air

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/advantage_air
